title: i18n(platform-objects): ship the platform objects, Setup, Studio and Account in Korean
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5xwArPxERFNdAjYY2nKcc9)_

Fixes #30512
Thread-read: 6723260365
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 加上韩语（ko）：平台对象、Studio 的元数据表单、Setup/Studio/Account 导航、系统概览仪表板和用户/组织记录页的内嵌文字，做法与已合并的 pt-BR（#31440）、ru（#31466）、de（#31511）逐文件一致。
- 为什么改：ko 是 #30512 七个语言里的最后一个，本 PR 合并即关闭该卡。目前 ko 用户在控制台里看到的 `sys_*` 标签全是英文。
- 风险与回滚：只新增 ko 文件、注册行和测试里的语言列表；已有语言一个字节都不变（其余 29 个生成文件不在 diff 里）；新文字同样走 source-hash 回退。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ko.ts`（导航钉住项），`ko.source-hashes.generated.ts`（45 条与英文相同的叶子，下面逐类列出），以及被 repeater-row-properties 拒绝后改为带父级名称的 3 个 `ID` 行（见 Acceptance notes）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/platform-objects && npx vitest run src/apps/translations/source-hash.test.ts src/apps/translations/repeater-row-properties.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的：生成文件让 PR 超过 3000 行，需要席位契约复审 ACCEPT，然后请人工合并。

## What changes
- New `ko` bundles in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: `ko.objects.generated.ts` (1704 leaves), `ko.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (1263 leaves), their provenance table `ko.source-hashes.generated.ts` (45 deliberate byte copies of `en`, listed under Acceptance notes), the hand-authored `ko.ts` (141 leaves) and `ko.source-hashes.ts` recording the `en` digest of every hand leaf.
- Registration: the extract config's `--locales` docstring and `translations:` baseline, `setup.translation.ts`, the `apps` barrel, and `metadata-translations/index.ts`.
- Inline maps: 36 in `sys-user.page.ts`, 6 in `sys-organization.page.ts`, and the System Overview null label in `system.datasets.ts` (`시스템`).
- Wording pins, as #31233 lists them: `nav_account_approvals` reads as plugin-approvals' `my_pending` label (`내 승인 대기`), `nav_assignment_rules` as `sys_assignment_rule`'s plural label (`배정 규칙`), each `nav_settings_*` (including `nav_settings_access_policy`, `액세스 정책`) as its service-settings hub title, `nav_settings_hub` as the console's `backToHub` (`전체 설정`), and the four #30935 keys: `grp_account_ai_assistant` = `AI 어시스턴트`; both `nav_connect_agent` entries and `pages.connect_agent.label` = `AI 어시스턴트 연결`.
- Changeset `.changeset/30512-platform-objects-ko.md` (patch).

## Tests
- `ko` added beside `de` to the locale lists of every test #31511 widened (vocabulary, nav parity, dead-key tombstone, source-hash, bu-rename with `old: /부서/`, the five identity copy tests, record-page tabs, null label, per-user stores, plugin translation loads), plus plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary`, plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` and service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity`. The cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` LOCALE_KEY shape already accepts `ko`.
- No new negative pin, for the same reason as #31466 and #31511: the plugin-audit twin test is outside this claim's file surface.

## Acceptance notes
- Every leaf is translated. The 45 byte copies of `en` the extract records fall into three groups:
  - Identifiers and protocol names (34): `ID` ×24, `API` ×2, `UI` ×2 (the `source` option of the two settings audit objects), `JWKS`, `JWKS URI`, `Message-ID`, `IdP SSO URL`, `snake_case`, and the SAML `urn:…:emailAddress` NameID format.
  - Lowercase option values and placeholder defaults that are identifiers (6): `cron`, `dlq`, `api`, and the `openid email profile` / `email` / `name` defaults.
  - The five JSON examples (5), kept verbatim as every locale keeps them.
- `repeater-row-properties` refused three `ID` echoes in repeater rows, so each now names its parent: `영역 ID` (app areas), `노드 ID` (flow nodes) and `에지 ID` (flow edges), matching how `de` and `ja-JP` name them.
- Vocabulary follows the existing `ko` plugin bundles: formal 합니다 style, confirm prompts ending `~하시겠습니까?`, `사용자`, `조직`, `사업부`, `직위`, `권한 세트`, `대기열`, `공유`, `레코드`, `승인`, `에이전트`, `스킬`, `도구`, `시스템 권한` (capability), and `상사` for a person's manager so it never collides with `관리자` (admin). Hub titles are exactly as service-settings spells them (`메일 전송`, `SMS 전송`, `파일 저장소`, `AI 및 Embedder`, `데이터 수명 주기`, …).
- Business units are `사업부`; `부서` appears only where the source says department (the `department` type option and the object description), which `bu-rename-consistency` allows.
- Deviation, as in #31466 and #31511: no plugin-audit `ko` twin of the #28107 activity-summary test, because plugin-audit is not in the claim's file surface.

## Verification
- `os i18n extract packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-Hant,ar,fr,pt-BR,ru,de,ko --fill=default --source-hashes --out=packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: a rerun regenerates the `ko` bundles byte-identical (`md5sum -c`) and leaves the 29 other generated files unchanged (none of them is in the diff). `check-i18n-bundles --filter=platform-objects`: in sync (32 bundles).
- `vitest run` in platform-objects: 120 files, 1931 tests passed. plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary` (6), plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` (5), service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity` plus `translations` (158) and cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` (27) passed.
- platform-objects `typecheck`: exit 0. `check:app-nav-i18n`: OK (13 contributors, 11 locales, 2 apps).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at e56cfa32 (on `origin/main` 8c75f837): 68 derived families, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0 (including `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:nul-bytes`).
- `origin/main` moved 2 commits past the base (2c6b9364, neither touches platform-objects, plugin-approvals or service-settings).
- `eslint` over the changed `.ts` paths (scoped, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0.
